business_summary: SinoDaan Co., Ltd. provides engineering consulting services in China. It also provides engineering supervision, electric power survey and design, cost consulting, bidding agency, project agency construction and management, smart engineering management and software research and development, and government procurement agency services. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Daan Project Management Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SinoDaan Co., Ltd. in April 2018. SinoDaan Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

SinoDaan Co., Ltd.는 2000년에 설립되었으며 중국 광저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
